rows.translation_en:
Of all places, she set fire to Hiruko's home...
Even normally gentle Hiruko
was absolutely furious at that...
She turned her into a cat on the spot and tossed her down!!
But lately, Hiruko seems to regret
having gone a little too far...

rows.translation_en:
As the name Crimson Flame Shrine suggests,
many of its oni and monsters wield fire.

rows.translation_en:
They say a heavenly maiden's child was stolen
by heartless humans. Her grief and hatred became
oni that haunt the buildings.
Soyokuin means the Temple of Twin Wings:
two passages run left and right from the main
sanctuary to the inner temple, like spreading wings.

rows.translation_en:
Oni and monsters with high Water and Wind
attributes seem somewhat more common here.

rows.translation_en:
Pass through the woods and climb three flights
of stone steps, and you'll see
a nine-story tower soaring into the sky.
I've heard that two deities
banished from heaven for some crime
are imprisoned on its top floor.

rows.translation_en:
Apparently, each floor has different oni and monsters,
so I imagine you'll need
a well-rounded party.

rows.translation_en:
This aqueduct was built for humanity by
one of heaven's mightiest gods,
who was also incredibly handsome!!
...But, well, I don't know
exactly what happened,
but it seems to be an oni nest now.

rows.translation_en:
The dungeon is full of water and ice.
Just getting around is a struggle.
Its oni and monsters seem strong in Water.
And the mermaid Manahime is immensely popular
with the male gods, so please do whatever it takes
to return her to heaven.

rows.translation_en:
If you help a woman with such deep feelings,
I'm sure karma will bring you a surprising reward
somewhere down the line... Or so I think!!

rows.translation_en:
I'll choose high-performance equipment
that each party member can use
and equip it more or less sensibly.
If several people can use the same piece,
I'll give priority to whoever was selected
for the party first.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
So select your party members in the order
you want them to receive the best equipment.
It's convenient and avoids waste.

rows.translation_en:
Incidentally, some weapons and armor
seem to have various effects besides
Attack and Defense...
But I don't worry about those little details
one bit, so please be generous
and let me get on with it!

rows.translation_en:
Accessories can increase Spirit, Skill, Agility,
and other abilities that weapons and armor
cannot make up for.
Most accessories raise
only one kind of ability.
And you can equip just one...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
But when you want to learn a particular spell sooner!!
When you know in advance which Skill attribute
the enemy's spells use!!
When you want to give a slowpoke more Agility!!
When someone's best moves don't match their Spirit
and aren't being used to full advantage!!

rows.translation_en:
At times like those, check whether
the right accessory is lying asleep,
snoring away in your storehouse.

At home, open Clan, then Details,
and choose Equipment for each person.

rows.translation_en:
Or when choosing your party,
leave it to me with Best Equipment.
It's a little rough, but quite convenient.
And when you obtain new weapons or armor
in a cave or dungeon,
try Equipment right away.

rows.translation_en:
To change weapons or accessories
during battle, open Items
and choose Equipment from the pack.
It seems complicated at first,
but once you learn it, it's easy and handy!!
Getting used to it is half the battle.

rows.translation_en:
With large armor equipped,
you'll be fine even in the front row
unless you're terribly careless!!
Make full use of the front row's
offensive advantages and finish the fight
with a bang!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
Naginata Wielders and Spearmen
can wear large armor.
Show us your grit on the front line!!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
This armor has the lowest Defense.
It's safest to think of light armor
as little more than peace of mind.
Gunners and Dancers
can wear only this light equipment.
Please be very careful.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
If you intend to stay in the front row
wearing medium armor against powerful enemies,
you'll need a plan or you'll be in danger.
Have a sturdy ally protect you,
or use spells to raise your Defense...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
Or perhaps keep telling yourself,
without a shred of evidence, that attacks
will absolutely never hit you...?
Archers and Martial Artists generally
fight in medium armor.

rows.translation_en:
Equipping armor
raises Defense and reduces
damage from enemy attacks.
There are two types, depending on where it's worn:
head armor, such as helmets and hats,
and body armor, such as cuirasses and kimonos.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
Each type has four levels of Defense:
light, medium, large, and heavy, in that order.
Your class limits which you can wear.
Many pieces are also restricted
to a particular gender or class.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
Stand firm on the very front line
and shield your own life and your allies'.
That's what heavy armor is for.

review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
Only Swordsmen and Crushers
can wear heavy armor!!
Get yourselves fired up
and give it everything you've got!

rows.translation_en: A weapon exclusive to Archers.

rows.translation_en:
It has quite high Attack,
and can fire arrows at enemies anywhere,
even from the back row.

rows.translation_en: A weapon exclusive to Dancers.

rows.translation_en:
From either your front or back row,
you can strike every enemy
in either enemy row.
But whatever you do, don't expect
overwhelming destructive power.
It's a fan, after all.

rows.translation_en: A weapon exclusive to Crushers.

review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
From the front row, its tremendous power
smashes one enemy in the enemy front row.

rows.translation_en: A weapon exclusive to Gunners.

rows.translation_en:
It can fire from either row,
and comes in spread-shot and single-shot types.
Spread-shot guns hit all enemies
when fired from the front row,
or the entire enemy front row from the back.

rows.translation_en:
Single-shot guns can pick off
an enemy anywhere in the opposing ranks,
whether fired from the front or back row.

rows.translation_en: Weapons exclusive to Martial Artists.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
From the front row, they attack one front-row enemy
with critical blows and lightning-fast triple strikes,
putting their speed to good use.
Their flying kicks across a row are powerful too,
but since claws and gloves go on your hands,
they may not have much to do with kicking power.

rows.translation_en: A weapon exclusive to Naginata Wielders.

rows.translation_en:
From the front row, it attacks the entire enemy front row.
From the back row, it can still attack
one enemy in the enemy front row.

rows.translation_en: A weapon exclusive to Spearmen.

From the front row, it stabs one front-row enemy and one behind.
From the back row, it can still stab
one enemy in the enemy front row.

rows.translation_en: A weapon exclusive to Swordsmen.

rows.translation_en:
It has high Attack and lets you slash
one front-row enemy from your own front row.

The Attack command in battle
attacks with your equipped weapon.

rows.translation_en:
Each class has
its own special weapons.
You cannot equip another class's weapons.
There are also a few weapons
restricted to men or women.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
The name is a pun on "records" and "oni."
It records the numbers and abilities
of oni and monsters you've defeated.
You can consult it before
charging into a dungeon or cave.

rows.translation_en:
If you keep investing in Religion,
the capital's residents may take it upon themselves
to build a monument to the %@ clan.
Or they may not build anything at all.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
People in Kyoto really go all out when they feel like it,
but when they don't, they do absolutely nothing...
Don't you think there are a lot of people like that?
Well, finding out what they build is part of the fun!!
Let's wait without getting our hopes too high.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
If the family grows and the house feels cramped,
but you have a little money to spare,
I'll be the one to suggest
an expansion to the house
to you, clan head.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
Let's add more rooms
so we can give new family members and adoptees
a great big welcome!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
You've reclaimed vases and tea utensils from oni,
but they're no use at all
in battle or while traveling...
Yet as human society grows more complicated,
things valued for nothing but their prestige
somehow really do become valuable.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.
Valuables' social prestige is the joke; they do not gain combat effects.

rows.translation_en: ...How strange.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
At any rate, they sell for a high price,
and giving them to family members
raises Loyalty a little.
Just owning them can make you feel
rather important...
Or perhaps not.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en: ...Very strange indeed.

rows.translation_en:
Shops in the Commerce sector
may hold big sales in February, May,
August, and November.
The details vary,
but thirty or forty percent off is nothing unusual!?
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
Unless you need something urgently,
wait for a big sale and buy in bulk!
That's sensible housekeeping.
But however cheap things are,
be careful not to buy things you don't need
and regret it afterward.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
This lists the main treasures
you've obtained on hunts.
It also gives you a rough idea
of how much you haven't found yet.
Collectors should find it useful.

You can check it before
charging into a dungeon or cave.

rows.translation_en:
Giving another clan a copy of a %@ clan deity,
or receiving a copy of another clan's deity,
is called Share Deity.

review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
Clan deities keep the family's surname.
Now, just imagine this:
your friends kneeling and praying
to a deity named %@!!
It gives you a little feeling of superiority. Ha ha!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

You cannot use Share Deity during play.
Save and quit, then
select it from the title screen.

rows.translation_en:
You can send a copy of one family member
to another clan as an adoptee,
or welcome an adoptee into your own family.
Bringing in another clan's blood
is an efficient way to make up for
traits the %@ clan lacks.

rows.translation_en:
Incidentally, you cannot return an adoptee
to their original clan
to make more copies of the same character.
Equipment and secret arts do not transfer either.
Trying to find an exploit and cheat
is a waste of time. Ha ha!

rows.translation_en:
You cannot use Adoption during play.
Save and quit, then
select it from the title screen.

rows.translation_en:
When a man and woman from the %@ clan
and another clan join together and have a child,
it is called Soul Union.
As the name suggests, this sacred ceremony
binds soul to soul.
Each person can propose it only once in a lifetime.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.
Soul Union is the mortal-clan ceremony, distinct from Divine Union.

rows.translation_en:
Both clans bear the curse,
so let's join hands and combine our strength
to fulfill our shared vow.
You cannot use Soul Union during play.
Save and quit, then
select it from the title screen.

rows.translation_en:
Sometimes genetic information
that did not appear as potential in a parent
blossoms in a child or grandchild.
We call this skipping a generation.
As you know, it's nothing
particularly unusual in the wider world.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
So even if the ability you hoped for
doesn't appear in one generation,
there's absolutely no need to worry!!
Let's believe in tomorrow
with all our hearts!
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
Humans and deities alike carry
two sets of genetic information,
one inherited from each parent.
For deities, choose Divine Union
to inspect both sets
whenever you like.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
Unfortunately, with humans,
there's no way to know
both sets completely.
But actually, during Divine Union,
if you're not too busy admiring my dancing,
you can catch a fleeting glimpse.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
Genetic information is divided
into three broad groups:
Spirit, Skill, and Body...
And each of those
has four attributes:
Fire, Water, Wind, and Earth...
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
Then there are two sets, paternal and maternal...
So that's three times four times two,
which makes...!?
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en: A whole enormous lot!!

Preserves the deliberately innumerate answer to 3 x 4 x 2.

rows.translation_en:
Phew... Well, for today,
let's just remember that genetics
is terribly complicated.

rows.translation_en:
The two sets of genetic information
inherited from the parents are mixed,
and half is expressed in that generation.
That expressed half is called potential.
It greatly influences growth, strengths,
weaknesses, personality, and much more.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
Open Clan, then Details, then Status.
The bar graph on the right side of the screen
shows that person's potential.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
Body abilities grow vigorously when you're young,
but suddenly stop growing much as you age.
Spirit and Skill, on the other hand,
can keep growing by leaps and bounds
even when you're older.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.
review_notes: Intentional source continuation fragments remain in their own rows. This help material has not been checked in-game.

rows.translation_en:
So if someone's potential lies in Body,
the rule is to train them hard while young,
even if they cry!!
For those with potential in Spirit or Skill,
I think it's better to encourage growth
with a longer view. Probably.
rows.context: Itsuka's encyclopedia, body entries 80-159. Previous entries 78-79 and following entries 160-163 examined. Dungeon lore, equipment, shops, clan relations, and inheritance. Runtime family members remain ungendered.

rows.translation_en:
In their ninth month, members of the %@ clan
become full adults in both body and mind!!
This is coming of age.
They're now quite ready to become parents!!
Choose a deity for Divine Union
and go all out!
